text:
Ava (CEO): Quick heads-up: this week we're shipping two things and finishing one policy update. Read and flag blockers by EOD Monday. Sync Wed 09:30 UTC.

Ava (CEO): Priorities: 1) EU private beta launch, 2) cost-reduction runbook rollout, 3) finalizing retention & audit policy.

Sofia (VP Eng): EU cluster ready. Provisioned 5 GPU nodes in eu-west, autoscaling tuned. Canary window Thu 21:00 -> Fri 01:00 UTC. Routing prefers dedicated; fallback to small-hosted.

Marcus (VP Product): Canary success criteria: p50 < 115ms, p95 < 250ms, customer error rate < 0.3%, token cost delta <= +9%. Any failure = immediate rollback + short RCA.

Priya (Head of Ops): Retention policy v2 summary: infra logs 90d, audit logs 18mo default, enterprise opt-in for multi-year. Added KMS-backed export and retention UI in Console. Legal review required before GA.

Elena (Head Legal): I'll aim to complete legal review Tue morning. Please attach the export flow diagram and KMS contract snippet.

Alex (Infra Eng): Quant presubmit ran on staging: ~2.6x memory reduction, tail latency +6% on long sequences. One eval family showed slight token differences; tagging for product review.

Marcus (VP Product): Put sample diffs into the canary dashboard and include golden outputs for quick eyeballing.

Alex (Infra Eng): Dashboard card pushed: per-route cost, sample diffs, and trace links.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @Sofia (VP Eng):
```
./deploy --env=eu-beta --version=2026.04.07-canary-rc1 --strategy=canary
```
Will post start/complete/fail. :rocket:

Raj (SRE): @eng-oncall we'll monitor latency SLOs, cache-hit ratio, and error surge detector. Escalation steps posted in runbook.

eng-oncall: Acknowledge. We'll post minute-by-minute updates during the window and escalate to SRE/Product if thresholds hit.

Jordan (Customer Success): Customer comms: drafting a short blurb for pilots and CS playbook for rollback scenarios. Will share Tue AM.

Lena (Finance): Cost playbook: finance model ready to run on the final runbook. High-level target: 10-16% unit cost improvement if batching + cache + quant adopted sensibly.

Ava (CEO): Action items: Sofia add canary links to calendar; Alex keep quant toggle per route; Priya confirm Legal signoff; Marcus prepare customer-facing note. 3-line runbook (owner + impact + ETA) to me by Wed noon for board slide.

Priya (Head of Ops): Added legal checklist to the launch doc and invited Legal to the canary channel. Will post final signoff here.

Sofia (VP Eng): Smoke tests green in staging. Ready to roll.

Ava (CEO): Thanks team. Keep this thread for brief status updates only. Move anything urgent to #release-war-room and tag execs. :eyes:
